task: Predict whether a module of NASA flight software for an earth-orbiting satellite has reported defects.
dataset_description: Static code metrics of each module: lines of code (LOC_*), McCabe complexities (cyclomatic, essential, design) and their densities, graph counts (nodes, edges, branches, conditions, decisions), and Halstead metrics (operators, operands, length, volume, difficulty, effort, error estimate, programming time).
